```{r setup overall environment, include = FALSE}

library(metpipe)
library(tidyverse)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  echo = TRUE,
  include = FALSE,
  eval = TRUE
)

```

# Data preprocessing general input
```{r 01_input_general, include = TRUE, echo = TRUE}

params <-
  params_setup( 
    
    path.mzml = "N:/SUN-CBMR-Metabolomics/Projects/AMP_test_project/mzML/EX_LIP_MS1/",
    
    standard.name = FALSE,  # TRUE, FALSE
    
    # Metadata
    path.meta.pos = "N:/SUN-CBMR-Metabolomics/Projects/AMP_test_project/files/meta/EX_LIP_meta_pos.xlsx",
    path.meta.neg = "N:/SUN-CBMR-Metabolomics/Projects/AMP_test_project/files/meta/EX_LIP_meta_neg.xlsx",
    
    meta.match.col = "Sample.name", 
    
    # Library match
    rt_tolerance = 0.3,
    mz_tolerance = 0.01,
    
    # Pool samples to use for evaluation
    po.sample.to.use = "PO",      # For evaluate normalization
    
    ### Only modify if not standard workflow
    method = NULL,
    path.result = "D:/work_folder/example_project/peaktable/EX_LIP_tar_mzmine/",
    sample.pattern = ".mzML",
    
    # Library path
    path.lib = "N:/SUN-CBMR-Metabolomics/Workflow/library/library.MS1.rds",
    path.lib.is = "N:/SUN-CBMR-Metabolomics/Workflow/library/library.MS1.IS.rds",
    path.msp = "N:/SUN-CBMR-Metabolomics/Workflow/library/msdial.library.MS1.rds"

)

params$author <- "xxx (xxx@sund.ku.dk)"
```

# 1 QC of internal standards
```{r 01_01_Preprocessing_IS, eval = TRUE}

params$mzmine.mz.tol.pos <- 0.01
params$mzmine.rt.tol.pos <- 0.4

params$mzmine.mz.tol.neg <- 0.01
params$mzmine.rt.tol.neg <- 0.4

run_module(module = "Preprocessing_IS",
           params = params)

```

```{r 01_02_QC_IS, eval = TRUE}

params$reference.type <- "reference" # reference or median

run_module(module = "QC_IS",
           params = params)

```

# 2 Targeted preprocessing - mzmine
```{r 02_01_Targeted preprocessing, eval = TRUE}

params$mzmine.mz.tol.pos <- 0.01
params$mzmine.rt.tol.pos <- 0.3
params$mzmine.min.peaks.in.row.pos <- 1

params$mzmine.mz.tol.neg <- 0.01
params$mzmine.rt.tol.neg <- 0.3
params$mzmine.min.peaks.in.row.neg <- params$mzmine.min.peaks.in.row.pos

run_module(module = "Targeted",
           params = params)

```

# 3 Cleaning
```{r 03_Clean_peaktable, eval = TRUE}

### Peaktable

params$path.peaktable.pos <- NULL
params$path.peaktable.neg <- NULL

params$peaktable.sep <- ";"
params$peaktable.sample.pattern <- ".mzML Peak area"

params$mz_col_nr <- 2
params$rt_col_nr <- 3
params$identity_col_nr <- 4
params$others <- c()

### Peak cleaning setup

# Feature filtering
params$mean.filter <- list(c( 3, "BL", "<", "PO"), # mean in PO should be > 3 times BL
                           c( 1, "PO", ">", 100))
                           
params$rsd.filter <- c(1, "PO", "<", 0.3)        # 0.3, RSD in PO should be < 30%
#params$rsd.filter <- c(1.5, "PO", "<", "Sample")        

params$rt.range <- c(0.6, 30)         # c(0, 30), only keep peaks in 0 - 30 min 

# Filter based on missings
params$filter_by_missing_feature_pct <- 50

run_module(module = "Clean",
           params = params)

```

# 4 Normalization
```{r 04_Normalization_comparison, eval = TRUE}

### Peaktable

params$path.peaktable.pos <- NULL
params$path.peaktable.neg <- NULL

params$peaktable.sep <- ";"
params$peaktable.sample.pattern <- ".mzML Peak area"

params$mz_col_nr <- 1
params$rt_col_nr <- 2
params$identity_col_nr <- 3
params$sample_col_nr <- 4
params$others <- c()

### Processing parameters
# Filter based on missings

params$missing.sample.thres <- 30
params$missing.feature.thres <- 30

# Misssing imputation
# "LoD", "HF", "median", "min", "mean"

params$missing.impute.method.sample <- "HF"  
params$missing.impute.method.is <- "HF"

# Sample types to remove from datatable
params$type.to.remove <- c("Met", "CA", "IQ", "sol", "BL")

# Normalization method
#c("bestis", "low_cv", "pqn", "loess", "sum", "median", "limma")

params$norm.method <- c("bestis", "low_cv", "pqn", "sum", "median", "limma")

run_module(module = "Normalization",
           params = params)

```

#### 5 Merge and map info
```{r 05_Merge, eval = TRUE}

### datatables

params$path.datatable.pos <- paste0(params$path.result, "04_Normalization_comparison/", "pos_normalised_bestis.xlsx")
params$path.datatable.neg <- paste0(params$path.result, "04_Normalization_comparison/", "neg_normalised_bestis.xlsx")

params$datatable.sep <- ";"
params$feature_col_nr <- 2

run_module(module = "Merge",
           params = params)

```

#### 6 QC report
```{r 06_QC_report, eval = TRUE}

run_module(module = "QC_report",
           params = params)

```
